plugins.name: ccmemo
plugins.description: Persist knowledge and plans across Claude Code sessions. Provides /record-knowledge, /plan-task, and /review-knowledge skills with Sonnet subagent delegation.

plugins.name: ccresmon
plugins.description: Claude Code resource monitor hook. Checks memory/CPU before Agent spawn and disk I/O before Bash execution.

plugins.name: ccevolve
plugins.description: Self-improving workflow for Claude Code. Enforces Knowledge-First Flow, detects recurring errors, and manages domain-specific rules.

plugins.name: ccorch
plugins.description: tmux pane orchestration for Claude Code. /ccor starts separate sessions in panes with 3-level depth control, for writes to another repository, work under the target repository's own permission and hook layer, and real-time supervised work.

plugins.name: ccaudit
plugins.description: Record and preserve audit trails of AI-assisted work so humans can verify and attest. Provides automatic Stop-hook flush to a remote trail repository plus /audit-flush for manual inspection.

plugins.name: ccguard
plugins.description: Deterministic PreToolUse guards for Claude Code. The first guard blocks git commits that carry AI/assistant attribution or session metadata.

plugins.name: ccharness
plugins.description: Harness for Claude Code. Eight leaf agent types with model and effort pinned per type, a tier guard, an agent ledger and parallel-worktree fan-out, plus scaffolded rules and permissions.deny, ship, worktree cleanup, a hard-deny floor hook and an always-on budget check.

plugins.name: ccwrite
plugins.description: Japanese writing for Claude Code: writing norms, a router that adapts text to the channel and recipient, a batch copy-editor agent, and warn-only checks for Markdown that renders differently from its source (emphasis next to Japanese punctuation, missing line-break spaces).
